ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a structural schematic diagram of a fish, with multiple letters labeling different parts of the fish through leader lines. The letter G is located on the far right side of the image, and its leader line points to the large fan-shaped fin at the end of the fish's body. Reasoning: The fan-shaped fin at the very end of the fish's body, used for propulsion and steering, is called the tail fin in fish anatomy, also called the caudal fin. Therefore, the letter G represents the tail fin.
